pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Product Request Before Confirming Order Changes
lesson.when: A customer requests to add or change an item in their selection to a product that has not been retrieved from sources or catalog searches in the conversation.
lesson.do: Search catalog sources to verify product existence, specifications, price, and availability before confirming the item update.
lesson.otherwise: State that you need to check the product information first or express uncertainty regarding item availability.
